name: Shimmer Of Madness

boost.name: Hanging By A Thread
effect: Your attacks have "HIT: If the opponent has 2 or fewer cards in hand, +2 Power."
HIT: Your opponent reveals their hand, then discards a card of your choice.

name: Absinthin Arrow

boost.name: We're All Mad Here
effect: Both players draw up to 4 cards, then discard a card at random.
HIT: The opponent draws a card, then discards 2 at random.

name: Plot Hook

boost.name: Time For Tea
effect: As an action, spend 1 Force to make the opponent discard a card at random. If you are in Exceed Mode, do not draw at the end of your turn.
HIT: Pull 5 and gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the strike).

name: Werelight

boost.name: Off With Her Head!
effect: If the opponent is at range 1, they choose one: The opponent discards 2 cards at random, or Push 3.
HIT: The opponent chooses one: The opponent discards 2 cards at random, or the opponent reveals their hand, then discards a card of your choice.

name: Color Spray

boost.name: Unhinged
effect: When you set a Wild Swing or EX Attack, your next valid attack gains: "HIT: The opponent must discard a card at random."
If the opponent has 2 or fewer cards in hand, Stun Immunity.
HIT: The opponent must draw or discard cards at random until they have 2 in hand.

name: Queen Of Hearts

boost.name: Wanderlust
effect: You may search your deck for a card and Transform it. The opponent may search their deck for a card and add it to their hand.
HIT: The opponent discards their hand, then draws a card. +1 Power for each card discarded this way.

name: Cat's Cradle

boost.name: Edge Of Insanity
effect: When the opponent uses the "Prepare" action, they draw 1 fewer card.
NOW: The opponent must discard a card at random.
HIT: The opponent draws a card, then discards 2 cards at random. -1 Power for each card in the opponent's hand.
